queries:
WITH c AS (
    SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM Examination
    WHERE ID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
s AS (
    SELECT ID, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share
    FROM c
),
m AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM s
)
SELECT AVG(s.cnt) AS avg_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(s.share - m.mean_share) AS avg_excess
FROM s, m
WHERE s.share > m.mean_share;
SELECT Thrombosis, CAST(COUNT(ID) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination) AS share
FROM Examination
WHERE ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Thrombosis;
